title: Pheins Legendary weapons
description: Legendary and overpowered weapons. (By me ofc) AND ITS CURRENTLY VERY BUGGY, WHEN ONE FEATURE WORKS THE OTHERS ALL BREAK!!!!!
body:
How is this plugin better than any other weapons plugin? Short answer, yes.

This is the spear and mace fantasy taken all the way. One Legendary Spear, one Legendary Mace, per server, ever. The moment a dragon egg shows up the whole map turns into a war over it, because that egg is the lock on the spear recipe. Whoever crafts first owns it outright, and everyone else is stuck watching the killfeed.

The spear is the centerpiece and it actually rewards knowing what you're doing. It rewrites itself depending on the dimension you're standing in. In the overworld you get the void pulse, a full warden sonic boom that fires out in front of you for ten hearts and leaves everyone caught in it darknessed,darkeneded? darknefied? Whatever you get the point. because you can make yo opps go blind you can open a fight before they even see you coming. In the nether the thing goes feral. The lunge enchant goes to to four, fire aspect works now (cuz its nether), and you can chuck a ghast fireball that detonates on contact. In the end you have a double jump and a slow fall toggle, so void movement and edge plays stop being scary. but you you're prolly too tuff for that.

And the lunge isn't flat and BORING anymore like you're used to. It tracks your full look angle, so you basically superman with . Every charged hit also marks the target with glowing for a minute, and a second charged hit while they're still glowing yanks them towards you. There's no running once you've hit someone. The spear is unbreakable, survives being dropped in lava, and probably the void. probably. (DISCLAIMER) lunge that is op works on all spears, so this spear takes NO SATURATION. your welcome

Then there's the mace, and you already know what the mace does in the right hands, you get high, then you hit them while you're falling and then every person in the ancient egypt of minecraft is calling socrates. It has density six, unbreaking five, mending, and wind burst uno--why did i make this so op? idk i was bored. AND it has a full extra block of reach so that makes five blocks instead of four. AND when you shift right click near your opps they get frozen, but they arent hopeless, the mace freeze thingy makes them rock solid so they get restistance 1, useful if you want to save your teammates or drain your opponents resources.

# HOW TO USE OP GOD SPEAR AND MACE COMBO
## First things first: get mace and spear.
legendary mace is crafted like regular mace with a side of luck. 5% chance, good luck.
but when someone gets lucky and makes the legendary mace, the chance bumps up to 25%, not because you can get you a very op mace, no! life isn't fair. so you get broken mace with no enchants. 
## Second things next
DEFEAT THE DRAGON and get the dragon egg, 
then craft it, for the admins they do /spearmap if they wanna hide a map of the crafting recipe. after allat you craft with 4 echo shards, diamond spear, blaze rod, nether star dragon egg, and silence trim. very difficult.
## Last thing
kill everyone (in minecraft) in your path and ruin the server. or not. idc its not my server.

lastly the whole server gets the equivalent of a discord @everyone ping every time either weapon is crafted, picked up, or dropped, so the holder is always known.

Everything's tunable too. Cooldowns, void pulse range, mace reach, drop rates, all of it lives in the config and reloads live. and if you want a useful tutorial and not this piece of crap i typed at 3 am at my grandmas house while eating kopetky. tutorial command is /lmas help
